selected_evidence.requirement: Shared VIP configured on node1/node2 with automatic failover, and node3 confirmed reachability across a transition
selected_evidence.summary: keepalived VRRP configured via UCI on node1 (MASTER) and node2 (BACKUP) for VIP 10.100.90.50; baseline showed VIP only on node1 and node3 pinging it successfully; stopping keepalived on node1 caused node2 to acquire the VIP within seconds while node3's continuous ping log showed unbroken sequential sequence numbers (0% loss); restarting node1's keepalived caused preemption back to MASTER, and node3 continued reaching the VIP

selected_evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline captured for every node
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id, keepalived service status, VIP placement, and node3's ping success to the VIP prior to any node restarts

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: reboot command on node2 closed the connection (acknowledgement); polling confirmed boot_id changed from 7ada57ca... to b587fa50... with uptime ~0; post-restart, keepalived auto-started and node2 rejoined as BACKUP with no VIP, while node1 continued holding the VIP as MASTER uninterrupted

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart (holding the VIP): acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state, and live failover proof
selected_evidence.summary: Continuous ping from node3 started before reboot; reboot command on node1 closed the connection (acknowledgement); node2 acquired the VIP within seconds (only a single dropped probe seq=5 in node3's ping log, then resumed) proving node3 kept reaching the shared address across the transition; polling confirmed node1's boot_id changed from 777e6ac8... to 5c3dd0b1... with uptime ~0; post-restart node1's keepalived auto-started and preempted back to MASTER reclaiming the VIP, node2 released it cleanly

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Captured node3 baseline boot_id and VIP reachability; reboot triggered connection reset (acknowledgement); polling confirmed boot_id changed from 9d52e625... to 9ac57698... with uptime ~1min; post-restart node3 regained its address and successfully pinged the VIP again, with node1 confirmed as healthy MASTER and node2 as healthy BACKUP
